num_items: <int> Number of items produced on the machine.
num_periods: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.
demand: <list[list[int]], shape [num_items][num_periods]> Quantity of each item required by customers in each period.
setup_cost: <list[int], length num_items> Fixed cost incurred each time the machine is set up to produce each item in a period.
holding_cost: <list[int], length num_items> Per-unit cost for storing each item in inventory at the end of a period.
variable_cost: <list[int], length num_items> Per-unit cost of producing each item.
setup_time: <list[int], length num_items> Time consumed from the period's capacity each time the machine is set up to produce each item.
variable_time: <list[float], length num_items> Time consumed from the period's capacity to produce one unit of each item.
capacity: <list[int], length num_periods> Total available production time on the machine in each period.
initial_inventory_cost: <list[int], length num_items> Per-unit cost of initial stock available for each item at the start of the first period.
